notes.decision: Use proper name Del Coronado Bridge. Draw a northern bridge on16between North Oak and the central peninsula; label placement may follow Draken, but location remains schematic.
Central old Night City is a peninsula, connected on its eastern side. Never turn it into an isolated rectangular island.

Keep wide San Morro Bay open westward. No direct north-to-south road bridge over its open water is shown in the supplied2020overview or primary regional freeway schematic; reach southern suburbs around east side or by canonical ferry transport.
Keep approximate Draken16 route / loop and proper Del Coronado Bridge; annotate regional route geometry as reference registration, not surveyed canonical coordinates.
Keep its approximate Draken corridor around the eastern city and through Heywood. Number 828 is confirmed by primary Sourcebook; exact bends, widths and interchanges on fan trace are schematic.
Keep its approximate Draken corridor through Pacifica/Rancho Coronado to the 828 system. Number 126 is confirmed by primary Sourcebook; exact fan line is approximate.

Do not silently relabel Draken external road as928. Primary Sourcebook confirms a parallel inland 928 route and828–928 North Interchange, but its registration onto the Draken trace is unresolved. Minimal honest map omits drawn 928 alignment and documents it in source/topology note until registered.

Draw as muted unnamed external highway if needed for visual context. Suppress California 1 / 101 number shields; neither fan label is established by primary schematic. Do not imply 928 geometric correspondence.

Primary freeway map showsNorCal Military Base near the easternDel Coronado Bay shore south of Westbrook; Draken anchors it far north. Keep a region-level mention unless a primary-plan registration resolves the location.
